segments.text: Your sugar levels are higher than last time, Mrs Okafor.
We will start metformine, five hundred milligrams, twice a day with meals.
Do not take ibuprofen for your knee while you are on this.
It can cause an upset stomach at first, which usually settles.
If you are sick and cannot keep fluids down, call the surgery.
